get.description: The pool, then the stored generated maps; never a per-match map (#884).

schema.title: Response List Maps Api Maps Get

get.description:
The map file as is (format: docs/design/map-format.md).

A per-match map (#884) is here once it is made; 404 while it is being made.
What ``GET /api/maps`` says of a map, for every map served here, a per-match one too.
The vector file of a map with a geography (format: map-format.md, DEC-36).

post.description:
Set the password of a guest (it becomes an account: nick, rating and history stay) or
change it (``old_password`` needed, 403 ``wrong password`` otherwise).

The token is replaced: the response carries the new one, the old one stops working (other
devices are logged out). Rate limited per player. 422 if the password is not 10..128
characters after NFKC normalization.

A new token of the account with this nick (any spelling with the same ``nick_key``).

401 ``wrong nick or password`` for an unknown nick, a guest without a password and a wrong
password alike, after the same scrypt work; 403 for a blocked account (only with the right
password). Rate limited per client IP and per nick. The previous token stops working.

get.description:
The running match of the player (a page reload, a second tab), ``null`` if none.

The player returns to it with the same token inside the reconnect window (DEC-05). A match
that is still waiting for its players (an invite) has no ``match_id`` yet: ``null``.

schema.title: Response Active Match Api Me Active Match Get

put.description: Change the nick (rate limited per player). The same rules as for a new guest.

Set the colour the player asks for in the next matches (DEC-49). A running match keeps
the colours it started with.

get.description:
The frames file of a finished match (``docs/design/replay-frames.md``), gzip as stored.

Rated matches: public. Others: 401 without a valid token, 403 for a player outside the match.
404: no such match. 202 (``Retry-After``): the match runs or the frames are being built.
410: the match is over and there will be no frames (failed build, crash, aborted match), or
the retention removed them (``reason: expired``, SRV-08).

202.description: The replay is being prepared: retry.

410.description: The replay expired (retention), or the match is over and none is made.

get.description:
The top 100 by the displayed rating ``r - 2 * RD``.

Only password accounts that are not blocked and finished calibration (DEC-34): at least
``min_rated_matches`` rating-changing matches. Public; rate limited per client IP.

Rating, rank, records and the last 20 matches of a player (a guest or an account).

Public; rate limited per client IP. An optional ``Authorization: Bearer <token>`` lets the
replay links of the caller's own unrated matches open (``replay.state`` ``ready``); for
anyone else they are ``private``. 404 for an unknown or blocked player.

404.description: No such player, or the account is blocked.

delete.description:
Leave the waiting room before the match starts: the invite is dropped (404 for others).

Either player may do it; the other one sees the invite gone (404). A started match is not
touched: leaving a running one is a ``Forfeit`` over the WebSocket.

post.description: Mark the caller ready; the second ready player starts the match.

get.description: Open public matches of other players, oldest first (the client polls every 2 s).
The public numbers of the main ruleset, without map tempo (the rules reference, #806).
The tutorial progress of the account (a guest has its own).

put.description: Replace the interface flags; the chapters done stay the server's.

get.description: The status; the client polls it every second (it is also the heartbeat).

post.description:
Enter the queue (or read the status if already in it).

429 with ``Retry-After`` and a ``QueueBan`` body while the player is banned for repeated
resigns (DEC-34); 429 with only ``Retry-After`` when the entry rate limit is hit.

delete.description: Leave the queue or decline the found pair; a started match is not touched.

post.description: Confirm the found pair; the second confirmation starts the rated match.

A report of the player's client into the server log (#810); 429 past the per-player limit
(``GOW_CLIENT_LOG_RATE_LIMIT`` within ``GOW_CLIENT_LOG_RATE_WINDOW_S``).

ActiveMatch.title: ActiveMatch
ActiveMatch.description: The running match of an account: enough to reconnect to ``/ws/match/{match_id}``.

total.title: Total
total.description: Calibration matches needed (a server setting, 5 by default).

Calibration.title: Calibration
Calibration.description:
Calibration progress of an account: the first matches of a rated account do not show its
rating (DEC-34, #414).

attrition_ticks.title: Attrition Ticks
attrition_ticks.description: Ticks over the capacity in a row before one unit dies.

grace_ticks.title: Grace Ticks
grace_ticks.description: Ticks after a capture in which the garrison is not counted.

CapacityPublic.title: CapacityPublic
CapacityPublic.description: Overcrowding attrition (``capacity`` of the ruleset), for the countdown of ui-style 12.

CapturePublic.title: CapturePublic
CapturePublic.description:
``capture`` of the ruleset (DEC-38): a capture spends ``charge_cost`` real charges of the
capturing groups in the node, with fewer they bounce; 0: a capture is free.

barracks_ticks.title: Barracks Ticks
barracks_ticks.description: Ticks from the full payment to the barracks.

barracks_charges.title: Barracks Charges
barracks_charges.description: The barracks costs this many charges (DEC-41, item 7).

warehouse_province.title: Warehouse Province
warehouse_province.description: The warehouse of every province holds this many charges (DEC-41, item 13).

CityUpgradesPublic.title: CityUpgradesPublic
CityUpgradesPublic.description: The barracks (DEC-26; ``city_upgrades`` of the ruleset) and the warehouse of a province.

ClientEntry.title: ClientEntry
ClientEntry.description: One thing the client noticed; repeats of the same kind and message are one entry.

ClientReport.title: ClientReport
ClientReport.description: ``POST /api/client-log``: a batch of entries or a "mark problem" dump (#810).

ClientSecond.title: ClientSecond
ClientSecond.description: One second of the timeline of a "mark problem" dump.

round_ticks.title: Round Ticks
round_ticks.description: Ticks between the rounds of a fight (DEC-24, item B): the round progress of a fight.

regroup_ticks.title: Regroup Ticks
regroup_ticks.description: The pause of an edge winner before it goes on (DEC-24, item G4).

retreat.description:
``round``: a group may leave a fight after the nearest round (DEC-24, item E); ``none``:
no retreat (DEC-40, variant N), the client hides the retreat hints and the cancel in a fight.

CostsPublic.title: CostsPublic
CostsPublic.description: Command costs in hundredths of CP (``orders.cost`` of the ruleset).

CpPublic.title: CpPublic
CpPublic.description:
CP: ``per_period`` hundredths per quantum, up to ``cap``; the period of the quantum is
``stances.cp_period_ticks`` of the own stance.

built_period_ticks.title: Built Period Ticks
built_period_ticks.description:
Every other factory makes one charge per this many ticks; ``None`` under
``stances.factories_follow`` (DEC-47): then it follows the stance like the capital.

build_ticks.title: Build Ticks
build_ticks.description: Ticks from the full payment to the factory.

max.title: Max
max.description: Factories of a player at most, the capital and the builds under way included.

FactoryPublic.title: FactoryPublic
FactoryPublic.description:
Factories (``factory`` of the ruleset, DEC-41, item 2). The own capital makes one charge
per ``stances.capital_period_ticks`` of the own stance.

build_ticks.title: Build Ticks
build_ticks.description: Ticks from the command to a working fortification.

toll_units.title: Toll Units
toll_units.description:
The toll: ``toll_charges`` per started ``toll_units`` units of an enemy group crossing the
line towards the node, never more than its charged units.

FortPublic.title: FortPublic
FortPublic.description: Road fortifications (``fort`` of the ruleset, DEC-43, item D).

rally_pct.title: Rally Pct
rally_pct.description:
A rally of ``n`` groups costs ``ceil(n * cost.move * rally_pct / 100 / 100)`` whole CP;
an attack ``cost.move`` per group (``cost.planned_move`` planned).

GroupOrderPublic.title: GroupOrderPublic
GroupOrderPublic.description:
The group order (DEC-48, ``[group_order]`` of the ruleset): ``group_move`` works and
``release_plan`` is disabled.

plan_ticks_per_bonus.title: Plan Ticks Per Bonus
plan_ticks_per_bonus.description:
A gathering planned order takes one charge and gains one bonus per this many ticks
(DEC-41, item 10).

PasswordSet.title: PasswordSet
PasswordSet.description: A new password; ``old_password`` is required when the account already has one.

PlayerColour.title: PlayerColour
PlayerColour.description:
The colour a player chooses: the set Engraved six (DEC-49, item 1). The values and the
allowed pairs are in ``gow_server.colours``; the client keeps the same values in its palette.

QueueBanned.title: QueueBanned
QueueBanned.description: Body of the 429 of a banned player: ``{"detail": {...}}`` like every HTTP error.

RatingChange.title: RatingChange
RatingChange.description:
The rating of the receiving player before and after a rated match (RAT-02, #75).

Both numbers are the displayed rating (``r - 2 * RD``, RAT-01), rounded to integers.

unit_ticks.title: Unit Ticks
unit_ticks.description: Ticks of production per unit: the full progress of the current unit.

queue_max.title: Queue Max
queue_max.description: Units in the queue of one city at most, the one in production included.

refund_started_pct.title: Refund Started Pct
refund_started_pct.description:
Share of ``cost.recruit`` a cancel returns for the unit in production; a unit not started
yet returns all of it.

rally_point.title: Rally Point
rally_point.description: DEC-48, item H: a city may send its new units to a rally point (``set_rally_point``).

rally_cost.title: Rally Cost
rally_cost.description:
Hundredths of CP a recruit pays when it leaves for the rally point (with fewer CP it stays
in its city, event ``rally_walk_no_cp``); 0 without ``rally_point``.

RecruitPublic.title: RecruitPublic
RecruitPublic.description: The recruit queue of a city (``recruit`` of the ruleset, DEC-25).

ReplayGone.title: ReplayGone
ReplayGone.description:
Body of ``410``. ``reason`` ``expired``: the retention removed the files (SRV-08);
``unavailable``: the match is over and no frames were or will be made.

ReplayPreparing.title: ReplayPreparing
ReplayPreparing.description: Body of ``202``: the replay will be there shortly (or when the match is over).

Retreat.title: Retreat
Retreat.description:
``combat.retreat`` (DEC-40, #626): ``round`` is the retreat of DEC-24, item E (a group
leaves a fight after the nearest round); ``none`` is variant N: a group that entered a fight
stays in it until the fight ends.

supply_dispatch_ticks.title: Supply Dispatch Ticks
supply_dispatch_ticks.description:
``supply.dispatch_ticks``: the supply dispatch runs on the ticks ``t > 0`` divisible by it
(DEC-43, item A6), so the countdown to ``View.me.next_dispatch_tick`` is exact from the first
snapshot (#705).

supply_leaf_shift.title: Supply Leaf Shift
supply_leaf_shift.description:
``supply.leaf_shift``: the player may move the level of the flow back with
``set_leaf_shift`` (DEC-43, item B). ``False`` (DEC-50): no lever, the shift stays 0 and the
command gives ``INVALID_ARGUMENT``; the client hides the lever.

group_order.description: DEC-48: the group order, ``None`` when the ruleset has none.

Sight.title: Sight
Sight.description:
What a source of vision shows of a neighbouring node (DEC-21, item 2): the detail levels
``exact``, ``range`` and ``presence`` of ``gow_sim.state.Detail`` (never fog).

SightRowPublic.title: SightRowPublic
SightRowPublic.description: What a source on one terrain shows of a neighbouring node, by the terrain of that node.

StancePeriodsPublic.title: StancePeriodsPublic
StancePeriodsPublic.description: Ticks per quantum under each stance (DEC-44).

cp_period_ticks.description: One CP quantum (``cp.per_period``) per this many ticks; ``View.me.cp_ticks`` counts them.

capital_period_ticks.description: One charge of the own capital per this many ticks; ``View.me.capital_ticks`` counts them.

factories_follow.title: Factories Follow
factories_follow.description:
DEC-47 (#888): every other own factory (built or captured) makes one charge per
``capital_period_ticks`` of the own stance as well, on its own counter, so a stance's charge
rate is this period times the own factories; ``False``: they keep ``factory.built_period_ticks``
whatever the stance.

StancesPublic.title: StancesPublic
StancesPublic.description: Stances with local progress (``stances`` of the ruleset, DEC-44).

TerrainDefensePublic.title: TerrainDefensePublic
TerrainDefensePublic.description:
``terrain.defense_mod``: charges added to the node defender's pool; a negative value burns
that many of its charges at the start of the first round (DEC-45).

TutorialFlags.title: TutorialFlags
TutorialFlags.description: What a client may write: the flags of the interface. Replaces them as a whole.

TutorialProgress.title: TutorialProgress
TutorialProgress.description: The whole progress, as stored and as ``GET /api/me/tutorial`` answers.

UnratedReason.title: UnratedReason
UnratedReason.description: Why a match did not change your rating (DEC-34, #414).

vp_period_ticks.title: Vp Period Ticks
vp_period_ticks.description:
``victory.vp_period_ticks``: VP are credited on every tick ``t > 0`` with
``t % vp_period_ticks == 0`` up to ``match_ticks`` (the first credit on the tick
``vp_period_ticks``; every kept ruleset's ``match_ticks`` is a multiple of it, so the last
credit falls on the last tick). A snapshot of tick ``t`` already holds the credit of ``t``
in ``View.vp``, so the next credit is ``vp_period_ticks - t % vp_period_ticks`` ticks away
(``vp_period_ticks`` right after a credit, never 0), with ``View.vp_gain`` its amounts.

VictoryPublic.title: VictoryPublic
VictoryPublic.description: The VP credit (``victory`` of the ruleset, DEC-03, mechanics.md section 11).

VisionPublic.title: VisionPublic
VisionPublic.description:
The vision table by terrain (``vision.by_terrain``, DEC-21, item 2): ``by_terrain.<source>.
<target>`` is ``exact``, ``range`` or ``presence``. The client only displays it (the legend of
the terrain map mode); the level of a place in the snapshot is decided by the server.

VisionTablePublic.title: VisionTablePublic
VisionTablePublic.description: One row per terrain of the source.
